layout.arrangement: No conventional title bar; the equation 'y = 0 x1 − 2 x2 + 3' sits top-center-right in a pale yellow highlight box. Left half is a large red-bordered square panel containing a 3D-style coordinate diagram with a yellow decision-boundary band. Right side, below the equation, is a boxed calculation panel 'Check Class of Test Vector'. Slide number '35' in a yellow circle at top-right corner. Entire slide framed by a thin dark-red border.

regions.name: diagram panel
regions.content: red-bordered square with 3D axes (x1, x2, y), yellow tilted band labeled W, class labels, data points, question-mark point

regions.name: calculation panel
regions.content: boxed text 'Check Class of Test Vector' with vector-matrix multiplication y = (1 7 3)(3 0 −2)^T = −3 ⇒ C2

layout.hierarchy: The large left diagram dominates visually; second is the boxed calculation on the right; the highlighted equation banner is a strong accent due to yellow highlight and red/blue colored numbers; slide number is minor.

visual_elements.description: 3D coordinate system drawn in perspective inside a red-bordered square. Vertical axis labeled 'y' with tick '3'; horizontal-right axis labeled 'x2' with ticks 1, 2, 3; diagonal lower-left axis labeled 'x1' with ticks 3 and 7. A wide yellow parallelogram band (decision region/hyperplane slab) tilts from upper-left to lower-right, labeled 'W' at its top. On the left edge of the band: blue text '-ve ( < 0 ) Class C2' above the band edge and red text '+ve ( > 0 ) Class C1' below it, with a small blue square marker on the boundary. Inside/near the band are small data points: orange/brown dots near coordinates (1,1) and (1,2) area and blue dots near (2,1) and (2,2) area, with thin dotted projection lines to the axes. A blue circle containing a white '?' sits at the lower end of the band near x1 = 7, connected by a dotted line to the x1 axis tick '7'.
Pale yellow highlighted equation banner: 'y = 0 x1 − 2 x2 + 3' with 'y' in black, '0' in blue, '−2' in red, '+3' in red; thin border around the box.

White box with thin border containing underlined heading 'Check Class of Test Vector' ('Check' underlined in blue, 'Class' in red, rest black). Below: labels X^T (blue, underlined) over row vector '(1  7  3)' with '1' in red, and W (blue, underlined) over column vector (3, 0, −2) with '3' in red and '−2' in blue. Result: '= −3' in blue, then red arrow '⇒' and 'C2' in black.
Yellow circle badge with dark outline containing slide number '35'.

imagery: No photographs; all graphics are vector-style mathematical diagrams (axes, yellow decision band, point markers, question-mark marker).
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout; mathematical notation in italic serif-like math font; equation banner is large and bold with color-coded coefficients; heading 'Check Class of Test Vector' underlined with mixed blue/red coloring; axis labels italic; class labels (-ve/+ve) rotated along the band edge.
animation_state: Appears fully built; the '?' marker suggests a query point being posed, but no partial bullet reveal is evident.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#F2F2F2) and draw a thin dark-red (#990000) border rectangle around the whole slide. 2. Top-right: draw a yellow (#FFFF99) circle with dark outline, place text '35'. 3. Top-center-right: add a pale-yellow (#FFFFCC) highlighted text box with thin border containing 'y = 0 x1 − 2 x2 + 3', coloring '0' blue, '−2' and '+3' red, rest black. 4. Left half: draw a large square with thick red (#CC0000) border. Inside, draw a 3D axis system: vertical y-axis (tick 3), horizontal x2-axis (ticks 1,2,3), diagonal x1-axis toward lower-left (ticks 3, 7). 5. Draw a wide yellow (#FFFF99) parallelogram band tilted from upper-left to lower-right across the square; label 'W' near its top. 6. Add rotated text on the left edge of the band: blue '-ve ( < 0 ) Class C2' above, red '+ve ( > 0 ) Class C1' below, with a small blue square marker on the boundary. 7. Plot small orange dots near (x2=1) and blue dots near (x2=2) at heights 1 and 2, with thin dotted projection lines to axes. 8. At the lower end of the band near x1=7, place a blue circle with white '?' and a dotted line to the x1 tick '7'. 9. Right-center: draw a white box with thin border; inside put underlined heading 'Check Class of Test Vector' (blue 'Check', red 'Class'); below, label X^T (blue underline) over row vector '(1 7 3)' with '1' red, label W (blue underline) over column vector (3, 0, −2) with '3' red and '−2' blue; then '= −3' in blue, red '⇒', and black 'C2'.
